system.description:
Wood-elf hunting tradition, built around forest terrain and patience.

  • Canopy Step: Running Shot's movement requirement is met by climbing or moving through trees/elevated terrain, not just ground movement.
  • Silent Nock: Advantage on Stealth checks made the same round you fire a bow.
